title: Build It Parallel
description: Tool for preserving coordinate data, generating parallel lines, and (hopefully) increasing build quality and efficiency.
body:
Tool for preserving coordinate data, generating parallel lines, and (hopefully) increasing build quality and efficiency while working on the BuildTheEarth project.

Build It Parallel on GitHub: [https://github.com/OtherCorbit/BuildItParallel](https://github.com/OtherCorbit/BuildItParallel)

### Default Keybinds
| Keybind | Action 
|-|:-
| X | New Node
| C | Delete all nodes

Nodes connect to each other and the ground with lines

More coming very soon!
